name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods in the Moonlight look: a mod manager, skill and prompt sidebars, a clickable effort pill, and the pill bar that switches between them

plugins.name: mod-app-statusline
plugins.description: Moonlight status line drawn above the prompt on the desktop app

plugins.name: mod-effort
plugins.description: A clickable effort meter in the prompt footer, five squares from low to max: click one to set that level, saved for the model like Alt+P does

plugins.name: mod-manager
plugins.description: Lists every mod and toggles it on or off; a click on a mod opens its page with its settings, actions and features. Opens from the gear in the pill row

plugins.name: mod-menu
plugins.description: Owns /mod-menu, which hides or shows the panel pills above the prompt; each panel mod draws its own entry there

plugins.name: mod-prompts
plugins.description: A sidebar of every prompt in this session, with the full text in a card: Enter or click jumps the transcript to it. Opens from /mod-prompts or the Prompts entry in the mod-menu pill

plugins.name: mod-skill-panel
plugins.description: Colors each skill in the slash list by the color-tag in its frontmatter, and /mod-skill-panel opens a sidebar of skills grouped by tag where pressing one adds it to the prompt

plugins.name: mod-toggle
plugins.description: Folds each finished turn under its prompt to one summary line and each tool call to one line, unfolded in place as a card by a click; /mod-toggle settings opens its settings
